name: Audio devices
description: Mute the microphone, change the volume, switch speakers and headsets, and set the volume of one app. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux.
author: PerritoDeck contributors

actions.name: Mute the microphone
actions.description: Mutes or unmutes the default microphone.

actions.name: Mute the sound
actions.description: Mutes or unmutes the speakers or headphones you're listening on.

actions.name: Volume
actions.description: The slider sets the volume, from silent (0) to full (100).

actions.name: Switch speakers or headphones
actions.description: Makes this device the one sound plays on. Give several names, separated by commas, and each press moves to the next one.

fields.label: Device name (or several, separated by commas)

actions.name: Switch microphone
actions.description: Makes this microphone the default one. Give several names, separated by commas, and each press moves to the next one.

fields.label: Microphone name (or several, separated by commas)

actions.name: Volume of an app
actions.description: The slider sets one app's volume (Windows and Linux). The app has to be playing sound.

actions.name: Mute an app
actions.description: Mutes or unmutes one app (Windows and Linux). The app has to be playing sound.
